title: The breach camera dives to the sinkhole as it opens; a playfeel section in the dev log; the turret sweeps 90 degrees; a smaller Talon
context: Owner playtest: the minigun is good, the Quiver needs work (a smaller missile for one); at the first tremor we see a top-down view and as the eruption starts the camera should zoom down fast to the sinkhole as the enemies emerge; a dev-log section for what feels satisfying and what needs work; the tank's turret rotates almost 180 degrees and should be 90.
outcome: Story breach shot: the whole planet through the pre-roll, then a 1.4 s eased dive to a pose five cells over the sinkhole pulled four cells toward the base, held through the emergence, then the tail blend (STORY_BREACH.diveSeconds, height, back). docs/PLAYFEEL.md holds the owner's dated notes and the log renderer appends it to DEVLOG.md as its own section. The tank's turret yaw comes from the authored Turret_Aim idle clip; mork's tick now scales the sampled yaw by TURRET_SWEEP (0.5) about the turret's own axis. STORY_QUIVER.missile.length 1.8 to 1.0. Controller folded back to 17,609.
alternatives: Re-author the Turret_Aim clip upstream: deferred, a runtime scale of the sampled yaw does it now and the constant is one line.
evidence: npm test, npm run check, browser --story-world before commit
